# Model Overview (for Diagnosis)
The probe expects a BERT4Rec network with catalog embeddings, a reserved mask token (`itemnum + 1`), and bidirectional sequence encoding. Inference retains the latest `L−1` history items, appends a mask, and left-pads to length `L`. The final representation is `encode_sequence(tokens)[:, -1]`; candidate scores are dot products with item embeddings. The backbone implementation is not supplied here.

# Diagnosis Inputs & Hooks
`DiagnosisProbe(view, device)` accesses the actual network through `view.model`, plus item embeddings, training histories and metadata interfaces. Training batches contain `(None, sequence, positive, negative)` with matching `B × L` tensors. Margins use `view.log2feats` and `view.predict_score`; integrity and sensitivity tests call the network directly. An embedding pre-hook captures live inference tokens. Diagnosis runs without gradients in evaluation mode, then restores module modes and Python, NumPy and PyTorch RNG states.

# Probes & Metrics
- **Integrity:** Checks reserved-mask identity, appended-mask token construction, finite scores, agreement with explicit reference scoring, and padding invariance. Required failures mark structural status `FAILED` and skip history sensitivity; missing checks produce `INCOMPLETE`.
- **Embedding alignment:** Samples up to 2,048 catalog embeddings and reports `(mean pairwise cosine + 1)/2`. Values near one indicate strong angular alignment; lower values alone do not establish quality.
- **Masked-target margins:** Inspects up to ten batches, scoring only valid supervised mask positions. Reports mean, tenth percentile, negative-win rate and margin-below-0.5 rate. Larger margins and lower failure rates indicate stronger training-target separation.
- **History sensitivity:** Uses the last training event of up to 200 users as a recovery target. Reports target score, rank, HR@10, hardest-negative margin, intervention deltas and top-ten overlap across three separate candidate draws, with user-bootstrap intervals and repeat/explore, length and popularity strata.

# Perturbation & Tests
Integrity fixtures cover empty, short, full and repeated histories. Tests perturb padding embeddings and right context, omit the mask, and use the incorrect `count−1` readout. Sensitivity removes or mask-replaces oldest/newest history blocks while freezing candidates. Changes reveal dependence on history content and positions, without establishing causal preferences.

# MODEL_DIAGNOSIS Schema & Limitations
`run_full_diagnosis` returns `{metrics, metric_definitions}`. Metrics group integrity, embedding alignment, masked margins and training-history sensitivity, with counts and unavailable reasons. The interpreter prompt requests grounded JSON findings. Sampler provenance, fresh-process checkpoint/predictor parity, attention deletion, unavailable metadata and four-category macro performance remain uncertified. Training-exposed recovery does not measure held-out generalization.
